brief:
An Israeli settler rammed his vehicle into a group of Palestinians in Tuqu, south of Bethlehem in the occupied West Bank, injuring at least eight people, Al Jazeera reported. The incident occurred in the town located in the southern part of the territory.

Details on the circumstances of the attack and the condition of the injured Palestinians were not immediately available.

title: Israeli settler rams vehicle into Palestinians in West Bank town
